topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's themes and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor virology and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how the study of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and establish the laboratory assays used to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Oncogene and tumor suppressor mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major classes of cancer mutations and demonstrate how pathway regulation, allele dosage, and mutation types dictate their functional impact.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the primary forms of genomic instability and the specific DNA repair, replication, and mitotic failures that cause them.

topics.label: Multi-step progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how the sequential accumulation of mutations and inherited germline defects accelerate tumor evolution and development.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation, offers to answer questions, and provides recommended reading.
